why: The one major reviewer, Tom's Guide, is off-target: its page is a winter-storm supply list with no solar kits. No authority shows up either. The hurricane-specific pages are an affiliate listicle on a recycled domain and one niche site that researched kits but didn't test them. Everything else is a retailer's own guide, a general roundup, or pages with no readable text. A focused hurricane kit page with current prices and outage runtime math would stand out.
